_comment: Manual fixes for the stats join (issue #55, packbuilder/stats.py). avonet, wingspan and birdbase map a BirdNET+ name (eBird/Clements) to the name the dataset uses, for renames, splits and lumps since the dataset's taxonomy; each says why. known_gaps lists species the build may leave without stats (none so far); threatened is the hand list of species protected where the packs are though the IUCN rates them lower.

Anarhynchus nivosus.name: Charadrius nivosus
Anarhynchus nivosus.why: Snowy Plover moved to Anarhynchus (Clements 2023); AVONET follows Clements 2021

Ardea ibis.name: Bubulcus ibis
Ardea ibis.why: Western Cattle Egret moved to Ardea (Clements 2023)

Larus smithsonianus.name: Larus argentatus
Larus smithsonianus.why: American Herring Gull split from Herring Gull (Clements 2025); AVONET's row is the species before the split

Numenius hudsonicus.name: Numenius phaeopus
Numenius hudsonicus.why: Hudsonian Whimbrel split from Whimbrel (Clements 2024); AVONET's row is the species before the split

Setophaga aestiva.name: Setophaga petechia
Setophaga aestiva.why: American Yellow Warbler split from Yellow Warbler (Clements 2025); AVONET's row is the species before the split

Tyto furcata.name: Tyto alba
Tyto furcata.why: American Barn Owl split from Western Barn Owl (Clements 2023); AVONET's row is the species before the split

threatened.Anarhynchus nivosus: the Pacific coast population of the Western Snowy Plover is listed as Threatened under the US Endangered Species Act
threatened.Dryobates borealis: the Red-cockaded Woodpecker is listed as Threatened under the US Endangered Species Act
threatened.Mycteria americana: the Wood Stork is listed as Threatened under the US Endangered Species Act
threatened.Polioptila californica: the coastal California Gnatcatcher is listed as Threatened under the US Endangered Species Act
threatened.Rallus obsoletus: the Light-footed and California Ridgway's Rails are listed as Endangered under the US Endangered Species Act
threatened.Rostrhamus sociabilis: the Everglade Snail Kite is listed as Endangered under the US Endangered Species Act
threatened.Vireo bellii: Least Bell's Vireo, the subspecies of southern California, is listed as Endangered under the US Endangered Species Act
